texts.en:
As we begin to biologically uplift the [target.GetGestaltEntityName], we must prioritize only those enhancements that will most benefit our civilization.

Selective gene manipulation allows us to breed specialists with desirable physical features who are best suited to specific industries.

With these newfound abilities, we have the opportunity to either bolster [target.GetIndividualNamePlural] who work in energy production, or defense.
